title: JBL Bar 500 MK2 5.1 Virtual Atmos Sound Bar - White $308.64 + Delivery @ The Good Guys Commercial (Membership required)
body:
Deal: JBL Bar 500 MK2 5.1 Virtual Atmos Sound Bar - White $308.64 + Delivery @ The Good Guys Commercial (Membership required)

[wintermadness] Great bar at this price. Dialogue is loud and clear, bass is plentiful (if a little loose). No upfiring speakers so Atmos isn't it's strong point. Tempted to grab another for the bedroom at this price.
[SubNoize] Compared to a Yamaha yas108/109 what's the improvement going to be like ?
[wintermadness] This actually replaced a yas107 (well, it replaced a TCL that replaced the yas107 - but the TCL sucked), but it's an all-round upgrade imo. Yamaha had surprisingly good dialogue, but this is better because it's got a dedicated centre channel. Better bass. Better format support & immersion for movies and games
The Yamaha + a sub goes a decent way towards matching it, but you'll be spending the $300 (or more) just for a decent sub to pair with it, without the other improvements
[bozzabear] Do you have this in a small room? From what I've been reading on reddit, the bass is great but the dialogue seems low/muffled behind other sounds.
[wintermadness] It's in a large open plan kitchen/dining room, and I bought it to help with dialogue clarity for casually watching FTA stuff, YT etc and it works great for that. Streaming series and movies sound great too. After calibration the bass was a bit high so I knocked it down a notch and there's no issues with it sounding muffled - even for a relative who has poor hearing.
